# 🎯 Objective
Implement robust exception handling framework with custom exceptions and proper error propagation.
---

## 📋 Tasks
- [ ] Create custom exception classes (`FrameworkException`, `ElementNotFoundException`)
- [ ] Implement exception handling in `Configuration.java`
- [ ] Add try-catch blocks with custom exceptions in `TextBoxTest.java`
- [ ] Ensure proper error logging for all exceptions
- [ ] Verify exception handling doesn't break existing CI pipeline

---

## 🔧 Technical Details
### Custom Exceptions
```java
// FrameworkException - Base exception for framework errors
// ElementNotFoundException - Specific exception for element not found scenarios
```

### Exception Handling Strategy
- Wrap all Selenium operations with proper exception handling
- Convert generic exceptions to framework-specific exceptions
- Maintain descriptive error messages for debugging
- Ensure proper resource cleanup in finally blocks

### Files to Update
- src/test/java/exceptions/FrameworkException.java (new)
- src/test/java/exceptions/ElementNotFoundException.java (new)
- src/test/java/config/Configuration.java (update)
- src/test/java/tests/TextBoxTest.java (update)

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria
- Custom exceptions are thrown for framework-specific errors
- All Selenium operations have proper exception handling
- Error messages are descriptive and help with debugging
- Test failures provide clear exception information
- CI pipeline continues to work without issues
